compute.hardware: Apple local CPU (14 logical CPUs); MPS detected but intentionally unused under the CPU-only pre-registration

deviations: The installed Scanpy 1.12.4 Seurat-v3 routine cannot index the AnnData 0.11 backed CSR adapter. H03 therefore implemented the same Scanpy per-study formula with Scanpy’s own aggregate and clipped-sum kernels, bounded to one study at a time. On a real 5,000-cell HLCA slice, the selected 2,000 genes matched Scanpy exactly.

The primary CPU-only scVI reference invocation was terminated externally by the execution platform after its two-hour tracked-background-job wait limit. It produced no model, checkpoint, ELBO history, latent matrix, or query fit. The platform does not provide final process CPU accounting or final peak memory after a forced termination; those metrics, the query audit, drift gates, and eligibility outputs are therefore null.

No frozen statistical parameter, model architecture, seed, source dataset, donor inclusion rule, or downstream test was changed. The local H01 input checksums and the required pre-data comparison test passed before preprocessing.
observations: Numeric ages retained 581,517 cells from 106 donors: 266,145 cells from donors younger than 45 years and 315,372 cells from donors aged 45 years or older.
The frozen all-donor Seurat-v3 selection produced exactly 2,000 HVGs across 14 study batches; no Rare cells were removed before HVG selection or scVI training.
The deterministic drift sample contains 56,904 unique cells across 106 donors and 24 non-Rare ann_level_3 types, with no donor×type group exceeding 60 cells.
The full preprocessing pass used a measured maximum resident set size of 7.38 GB, below H03’s approximately 28 GB stop threshold.
The published HLCA embedding source is 30-dimensional; it was not used for a drift fit before the primary mapping was externally terminated.
questions: May Claude issue a revised H03 task that authorizes a persistent execution environment (or another explicitly approved execution strategy) for the same frozen CPU-only 400-epoch young-reference and query fits? The current platform terminates the run before it writes a reproducible checkpoint or any mapped output.
suggestions: Run the unchanged frozen primary mapping in an environment that can retain the local data and model state beyond the platform’s two-hour tracked-job limit, because it is a computational-execution blocker rather than a biological or statistical result.

If a revised task permits a checkpointing strategy, require a checkpoint and per-epoch history at deterministic intervals so an external interruption can be resumed and audited without discarding the frozen fit.
